features.description: initTaskProcessing failure exits non-zero (D1); NewWorktreeManager validates a supplied repoDir instead of accepting an unresolvable path and failing later on every CleanupOrphaned
acceptance_criteria: Coordinator started with CWD outside a git repo exits non-zero with an actionable message naming the fix
NewWorktreeManager with a nonexistent repoDir returns an error at construction
NewWorktreeManager on a valid repo still succeeds

features.description: Add triage_only to agent/inbox config (D2) and assert at startup that every inbox is either agent-served or explicitly triage_only, so 'no agent' stops being ambiguous between intended and forgotten. public-feedback is triage_only; Discord is its routing (verified delivering).
acceptance_criteria: triage_only: true parses and round-trips through agent config
A triage_only inbox is never dispatched
An inbox with neither an agent nor triage_only is a startup error naming the inbox

features.description: Add execution_lane local|cloud and a separate repo coordinate (D3) so the lane is declared, not inferred from whether workspace starts with a slash. Back-compat: all 39 cloud agents carry a bare org/repo workspace and MUST infer cloud.
acceptance_criteria: execution_lane parses; absent infers org/repo->cloud and absolute path->local
Regression test pins that all 39 existing cloud agents infer cloud
eval-rig resolves local and yields no cloud dispatch
Deprecation warning when a bare org/repo workspace is used as a repo coordinate

features.description: ailang coordinator config get|set|diff with an if-generation-match precondition. No generation precondition exists anywhere in the repo today (0 grep hits) and a lost update was demonstrated live: a 14:24:33Z write clobbered at 14:37:10Z with no error on either side.
acceptance_criteria: get records the generation it fetched
set against a stale generation is refused, naming both generations
set validates YAML and agent invariants before writing
--force retained but must name the generation it overwrites
